zh-CN.summary: 需要登录的 LLM 聊天界面，许可要求保留其品牌标识。

metadata.name: Open WebUI
metadata.summary: A chat interface for LLMs with sign-in; its licence asks you to keep its branding.

zh-CN.summary: 网页界面和 pipeline 服务都以 UID 1000 运行，没有额外的系统权限，镜像只读。第一组管理员账号密码和 pipeline API 密钥都是自动生成的。注册功能已关闭。

zh-TW.summary: 網頁介面和 pipeline 服務都以 UID 1000 執行，沒有額外的系統權限，映像檔唯讀。第一組管理員帳密和 pipeline API 金鑰都是自動產生的。註冊功能已關閉。

zh-CN.mitigation: 模板说明里有写明许可。上游所有的品牌标识都要保留。第 4 节只允许在 30 天内最多 50 位终端用户的情况下改品牌，或是取得书面或企业授权。这个模板保留了上游的品牌标识。
zh-CN.risk: Open WebUI 用的是自定义许可。源码看得到，但不算 OSI 认可，而且对品牌标识有规定。

zh-TW.mitigation: 範本說明裡有寫明授權。上游所有的品牌標示都要保留。第 4 節只允許在 30 天內最多 50 位終端使用者的情況下改品牌，或是取得書面或企業授權。這個範本保留了上游的品牌標示。
zh-TW.risk: Open WebUI 用的是自訂授權。原始碼看得到，但不算 OSI 認可，而且對品牌標示有規定。

risks.mitigation: The template description names the license. Keep all the upstream branding. Section 4 allows branding changes only for at most 50 end users in a rolling 30-day period, or with written or enterprise permission. This template keeps the upstream branding.
risks.risk: Open WebUI uses a custom license. You can read the source, but it is not OSI-approved, and it has branding rules.

zh-CN.mitigation: 每个安装的 pipeline 和依赖包，都要当成应用代码，完全信任了才装。pipeline 服务要保持私有，只让网页界面连得到。它没有 Kubernetes 令牌，也没有主机 socket。对外连接没有限制，所以请加一条 egress NetworkPolicy（限制对外连接的规则），让 pipeline 连不到私有地址。Python 包会装到可写入的 pipeline 存储卷。需要 root 的包（apt 或浏览器用的系统库）无法在运行时安装，请自己打包进固定版本的镜像。
zh-CN.risk: Pipeline 和管理员添加的工具会运行 Python 代码，而且拿得到服务商的凭据。

zh-TW.mitigation: 每個安裝的 pipeline 和相依套件，都要當成應用程式的程式碼，完全信任了才裝。pipeline 服務要保持私有，只讓網頁介面連得到。它沒有 Kubernetes 權杖，也沒有主機 socket。對外連線沒有限制，所以請加一條 egress NetworkPolicy（限制對外連線的規則），讓 pipeline 連不到私有位址。Python 套件會裝到可寫入的 pipeline 儲存空間。需要 root 的套件（apt 或瀏覽器用的系統函式庫）無法在執行時安裝，請自己打包進固定版本的映像檔。
zh-TW.risk: Pipeline 和管理員加的工具會執行 Python 程式碼，而且拿得到服務商的認證資訊。

risks.mitigation: Treat every installed pipeline and dependency as application code and trust it fully. Keep the pipeline service private so only the web interface can reach it. It has no Kubernetes tokens or host sockets. Outbound traffic is not limited, so add an egress NetworkPolicy (a rule that limits outbound traffic) to keep pipelines away from private addresses. Python packages install to the writable pipeline volume. Packages that need root (apt or system libraries for a browser) cannot install at runtime. Build them into your own pinned image.
risks.risk: Pipelines and tools added by administrators run Python code with access to provider credentials.

zh-CN.mitigation: 连接每个服务商之前，请先读过它的隐私条款。Ollama 已停用，服务商的连接请到管理员设置里自己加。
zh-CN.risk: 外部的模型服务商会收到你的对话内容和上传文档的数据。

zh-TW.mitigation: 連接每個服務商之前，請先讀過它的隱私條款。Ollama 已停用，服務商的連線請到管理員設定裡自己加。
zh-TW.risk: 外部的模型服務商會收到你的對話內容和上傳文件的資料。

risks.mitigation: Read each provider's privacy terms before you connect it. Ollama is disabled. Add provider connections in the admin settings.
risks.risk: External model providers receive your chat content and the data from documents you upload.

security.summary: The web interface and the pipeline service both run as UID 1000 with no extra system privileges and read-only images. The first admin credentials and the pipeline API key are generated. Sign-up is disabled.

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: open-webui-data
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: pipeline-data
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 5Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: open-webui
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  revisionHistoryLimit: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: open-webui
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: open-webui
        app.kubernetes.io/name: open-webui
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: open-webui
        image: ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main@sha256:4860ba005ae8f19f08d1e12b0868855b7b339ea0dad9927f196820fc0de04575
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 8080
        env:
        - name: HOME
          value: /app/backend/data/home
        - name: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE
          value: '1'
        - name: WEBUI_URL
          value: https://{{ .Domain }}
        - name: WEBUI_ADMIN_EMAIL
          value: '{{ .Inputs.adminEmail }}'
        - name: WEBUI_ADMIN_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: app-secrets
              key: admin-password
        - name: WEBUI_SECRET_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: app-secrets
              key: session-key
        - name: ENABLE_SIGNUP
          value: 'false'
        - name: ENABLE_PERSISTENT_CONFIG
          value: 'false'
        - name: ENABLE_OLLAMA_API
          value: 'false'
        - name: OPENAI_API_BASE_URL
          value: http://pipeline:9099
        - name: OPENAI_API_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: app-secrets
              key: pipeline-key
        - name: SCARF_NO_ANALYTICS
          value: 'true'
        - name: DO_NOT_TRACK
          value: 'true'
        - name: ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY
          value: 'false'
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
        resources: &id001
          requests:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 1Gi
          limits:
            cpu: '2'
            memory: 4Gi
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /app/backend/data
        - name: static
          mountPath: /app/backend/open_webui/static
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: http
          failureThreshold: 90
          periodSeconds: 5
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 30
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: open-webui-data
      - name: static
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 100Mi
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 1Gi
      initContainers:
      - name: seed-runtime-assets
        image: ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main@sha256:4860ba005ae8f19f08d1e12b0868855b7b339ea0dad9927f196820fc0de04575
        command:
        - python
        - -c
        - 'import shutil,subprocess

          from pathlib import Path

          subprocess.run([''cp'',''-R'',''/app/backend/open_webui/static/.'',''/seed-static/''],check=True)

          cache=Path(''/seed-data/cache'')

          if not cache.exists(): shutil.copytree(''/app/backend/data/cache'',cache)

          Path(''/seed-data/home'').mkdir(exist_ok=True)

          '
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
        resources: *id001
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /seed-data
        - name: static
          mountPath: /seed-static
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: open-webui
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: open-webui
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 8080
    targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: pipeline
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: pipeline
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 9099
    targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: open-webui
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: '{{ .ClusterIssuer }}'
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
  - hosts:
    - '{{ .Domain }}'
    secretName: open-webui-tls
  rules:
  - host: '{{ .Domain }}'
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: open-webui
            port:
              number: 8080
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: pipeline
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  revisionHistoryLimit: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: pipeline
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: open-webui
        app.kubernetes.io/name: pipeline
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: pipeline
        image: ghcr.io/open-webui/pipelines:main@sha256:b48e9bc338ce2be0acfbeff01810db72408a12f07739f9e3879c1f2b00952d6e
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 9099
        env:
        - name: HOME
          value: /app/pipelines/home
        - name: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE
          value: '1'
        - name: PYTHONPATH
          value: /app/pipelines/.packages
        - name: PIP_TARGET
          value: /app/pipelines/.packages
        - name: PIP_CACHE_DIR
          value: /app/pipelines/.cache
        - name: PIPELINES_DIR
          value: /app/pipelines
        - name: PIPELINES_API_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: app-secrets
              key: pipeline-key
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 512Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '2'
            memory: 2Gi
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /app/pipelines
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: http
          failureThreshold: 90
          periodSeconds: 5
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 30
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: pipeline-data
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 1Gi
